_doc: Representative role profiles (not live job postings). Each is matched with the same scoring engine as a pasted job description.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.text:
Software Developer
Requirements:
- Programming in Java, Python or C++.
- Knowledge of data structures and algorithms and object-oriented programming.
- Experience with SQL and Git.
- Good communication skills.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field.
Nice to have:
- REST API development is a plus.
- Unit testing is a plus.

roles.title: Python Developer
roles.text:
Python Developer
Requirements:
- Strong Python skills.
- Experience with Django or Flask and REST API development.
- Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Git and version control.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Docker is a plus.
- AWS is a plus.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.text:
Frontend Developer
Requirements:
- HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
- Experience with React.
- Git.
- UI/UX design sense and Figma.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- TypeScript is a plus.
- REST API integration is a plus.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.text:
Full-Stack Developer
Requirements:
- JavaScript, HTML and CSS with React.
- Backend development with Node.js, Python or Java.
- SQL and MongoDB databases.
- REST API development.
- Git.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Docker is a plus.
- Firebase is a plus.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.text:
Backend Developer
Requirements:
- Java or Python backend development.
- Spring Boot, Django or Flask.
- REST API design and SQL.
- Git.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Docker and Kubernetes are a plus.
- Microservices is a plus.

roles.title: Java Developer
roles.text:
Java Developer
Requirements:
- Strong Java and object-oriented programming.
- SQL and JDBC or Hibernate.
- Git.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Spring Boot is a plus.
- JUnit is a plus.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.text:
Data Analyst
Requirements:
- SQL and Excel.
- Python with pandas.
- Data visualization with Tableau, Power BI or Matplotlib.
- Good communication skills.
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Machine learning is a plus.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.text:
Machine Learning Engineer
Requirements:
- Python and machine learning.
- Deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch.
- Experience with pandas and NumPy.
- Computer vision or NLP projects.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Docker is a plus.
- SQL is a plus.

roles.title: QA / Software Test Engineer
roles.text:
QA Engineer
Requirements:
- Software testing and test cases.
- Test automation with Selenium or pytest.
- SQL.
- Good communication skills.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field.
Nice to have:
- Java or Python is a plus.
- Agile is a plus.

roles.title: Cloud / DevOps Engineer
roles.text:
Cloud DevOps Engineer
Requirements:
- Linux and Bash scripting.
- Docker and Kubernetes.
- CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
- AWS, Azure or GCP.
- Git.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- Terraform is a plus.
- Python is a plus.

roles.title: Mobile App Developer
roles.text:
Mobile App Developer
Requirements:
- Flutter or Kotlin or Swift.
- Firebase.
- REST API integration.
- Git.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- UI/UX design with Figma is a plus.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.text:
UI/UX Designer
Requirements:
- UI/UX design and prototyping in Figma.
- HTML and CSS.
- Good communication skills.
- Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science or related field.
Nice to have:
- JavaScript is a plus.
